correctness.rationale: The exact conditional hub-event probability is positive under all w_ij>0. Independent leaf attachments yield m_ij=1+sum_{k!=j}p_ik. Summing over j recovers p_ij, and independence of entire degree arrays forces p_ij constant in j. Conversely the weighted Matrix-Tree cofactor for multiplicatively separated weights factors, giving two independent multinomial degree arrays. Fourteen exact-rational small cases independently corroborated all identities. Finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: A natural classification of when opposite-side degree profiles of a Gibbs spanning tree decouple over all strictly positive edge-weight matrices and every nontrivial complete bipartite size. Unlike a routine isolated moment, the theorem includes a positive-weight rigidity converse and an exact inverse map from conditional degree means, useful to detect and quantify heterogeneous edge preference without observing individual edges. The positivity/no-star restrictions are mathematically justified.
